title: House hunting on Maryland Street
summary: Louella said she had money, and they found a two-flat building on Maryland across from a school.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Meeting, courting and marrying: musicians' love lives

blocks.x: So, all we got along real good. So I kept a runnin' up an' down the road an' went off an' leave them. So finally, she said, "We gonna move outa this hotel and buy us a home."

I say, "With what? I ain't got no money to buy no home."
She said, "I got some money."
I say, "Well, that be your home."
"You my husband. Be our home." Said, "It won't take long
to make it back up. You workin' off the time. You workin' plenty...
you workin' regular." She say, "You just have to stop throwin' your
money away on drinks."
"Okay. Okay, I'll...jus' lighten up. I'll check up."

So we got in a cab and went out lookin'. So we found a house
on Maryland, right across from the school. Went up there an' talked to
the people. Was a two-flat buildin'. So she said, "How you like this?"

Me, I'm silly. "Yeah, it's all right. I guess it's okay."
I tol' her, "But it ain't got no big back yard."

She say, "Well, we don't need no big back yard. Big enough
for you to get back there...do anything you want." Say, "You ain't saw
the place yet."
